claims.label: Summary
claims.explanation: HB 1001 would expand the required mental-health-leave policy to each state or political-subdivision entity that employs a covered public safety employee, when the employee experiences a traumatic event in the scope of employment. Coverage would include firefighters, detention officers, county jailers, and emergency medical services employees, as well as peace officers and telecommunicators; policies must provide leave without salary or other compensation deduction and specify leave guidelines, days, and anonymity.
Expands the public safety employees covered by required mental-health-leave policies.
claims.label: Public safety

claims.explanation: Extends a required employment leave policy and its compensation protections to additional public safety employees.
